summary: First brief under the new ~70% phone allocation. Nothing's mysterious screen-free AI device teaser leads, backed by two real phone comparisons (RedMagic vs Galaxy S25 Ultra, Poco X8s vs Galaxy S23 Ultra), a Pixel 11 deal, and an iPhone Pro redesign leak.
